create_FlowDataset: create a FlowDataset instance with a specified split and optional augmentation for optical flow training
build_get_train_dataset_flow: build a training dataset from a string specification like TartanAirDataset(train) with augmentation enabled
build_get_test_datasets_flow: build a list of test datasets from a string specification like Kitti15Dataset(test)+Kitti12Dataset(test)
run_flowToColor: run flowToColor on a numpy flow array to generate a color-coded visualization image
readFlowFile_writeFlowFile: read a .flo optical flow file into a numpy array or write flow predictions to a .flo file
